purpose: RT-V8 P7 (owner, 2026-10-28, as recommended): DEC-058 check (c) scope, generated by tools/release/generate_provenance_scope.py. A provenance object with violations is scoped out only when its file is listed here by path, the file's bytes hash to the listed SHA-256, and its exact (redistribution_status, review_status) JSON values are a listed pair ("<missing>" for an absent field). A file is listed only when one of its provenance records declares invented content (redistribution_status invented_non_engineering_example, or 'invented' in origin, source_name or contributor_certification). Scoped objects are counted and named in the scan record.
